regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA threat index 2.35 (STABLE, steady): Iran, Oman tensions rise

bullets.text: Iran's military conflicts and geopolitical tensions drive the index, with recent incidents involving oil tankers and US-Iran war threats
Oman's strategic location and involvement in regional conflicts contribute to its high index score, including a reported projectile strike on a cargo vessel off its coast
The stable composite index of 2.35 reflects the ongoing, steady nature of these regional security concerns, with Iran and Oman being key drivers of the current threat landscape

markets.headline: Index forecast rising; Brent +0.3%; gold +0.2%; VIX +0.3% (model estimate).
markets.method_note: Threat beta = OLS of daily log-returns on the index change at the lead lag; launch-day estimates lean on BNTI-seeded history. Association, not causation.
